Metadata.Title: Ratchet and Clank
Metadata.Name: 1728p (PS4 Pro mode)
Metadata.Note: 3072x1728 render in PS4 Pro mode instead of 2560x1440, scaled to the 3840x2160 output. The render width must be a multiple of 256, so the steps are 1728p and 1872p instead of 1620p and 1800p. Enable only one resolution entry.
Metadata.Author: gasb07
